name: Yokubou no Natsu
source:
A summer day.
You happens to find a woman who has lost consciousness.
It may be vital if the treatment is not immediately given.
However, you are sexually excited before the woman in a coma.
What action do you take?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051759.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某个夏日。
你偶然发现了一名昏迷不醒的女性。
若不立即施以急救，恐怕会有生命危险。
然而面对眼前人事不省的女人，你却不由自主地欲火焚身。
你究竟会采取怎样的行动？
